description: Defines internal structures and functions for socket waiting using libevent, including Waitee struct, callback handlers, and thread-safe wakeup mechanisms.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
classes.description: Internal implementation of socket waiter using libevent, managing waitees, callbacks, and thread-safe wakeup.

classes.name: Waitee
classes.description: Represents a socket registration with callback and interests, backed by libevent.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Registers a socket with the waiter with specified interests and callback.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a socket from the waiter.

methods.name: WaitTimed
methods.description: Waits for an event with a timeout.

methods.name: WakeUp
methods.description: Wakes up the waiter, optionally due to a timeout.
